steps.label: helpers
steps.js: (() => { window.T = { sleep: (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), q: (s) => document.querySelector(s), send: async (text) => { const b = document.getElementById('say'); b.value = text; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); b.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); for (let k = 0; k < 12 && !document.getElementById('working'); k++) await T.sleep(250); for (let k = 0; k < 60 && document.getElementById('working'); k++) await T.sleep(250); await T.sleep(1200); }, icon: (k) => document.querySelector(`#rail [data-panel=${k}]`), open: () => !document.getElementById('side-panel').hidden, act: () => { const a = document.activeElement; return a ? (a.id || a.dataset.panel || a.dataset.act || a.className) : null; } }; return 'ok'; })()

steps.label: 1 layout: no right column, no Ask the lead to, Features 340 px, rail closed, no badge
steps.js: (() => ({ endColumn: !!T.q('.column.end'), askButtons: document.querySelectorAll('[data-act=prompt]').length, leftWidth: T.q('.column.wide').getBoundingClientRect().width, rail: !!T.q('#rail'), open: T.open(), badge: T.q('#rail .dot') ? T.q('#rail .dot').textContent : null, label: T.icon('proposals').getAttribute('aria-label') }))()

steps.label: 2 badge follows the conversation live
steps.js: (async () => { await T.send('Propose e-mail'); for (let k = 0; k < 40 && !T.q('#rail .dot'); k++) await T.sleep(250); const one = T.q('#rail .dot') && T.q('#rail .dot').textContent; await T.send('Propose stock'); await T.send('Propose receipts'); return { afterOne: one, afterThree: T.q('#rail .dot') && T.q('#rail .dot').textContent, label: T.icon('proposals').getAttribute('aria-label') }; })()

steps.label: 3 open by its icon: focus on the heading, only unstarted proposals, ends above the message box
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(300); const p = T.q('#side-panel'); const box = T.q('#chat-col .composer'); return { open: T.open(), expanded: T.icon('proposals').getAttribute('aria-expanded'), focus: T.act(), titles: [...p.querySelectorAll('.prop .b')].map((e) => e.textContent), starts: p.querySelectorAll('[data-act=start-feature]').length, gapToComposer: Math.round(box.getBoundingClientRect().top - p.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) }; })()

steps.label: 4 the same icon closes it, focus back on the icon
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); return { open: T.open(), expanded: T.icon('proposals').getAttribute('aria-expanded'), focus: T.act() }; })()

steps.label: 5 Escape inside the panel closes it, focus back on the icon
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); T.q('#side-panel [data-act=start-feature]').focus(); document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Escape', bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(200); return { open: T.open(), focus: T.act() }; })()

steps.label: 6 Escape in the message box leaves the panel alone
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); const b = T.q('#say'); b.focus(); b.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Escape', bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(200); return { open: T.open() }; })()

steps.label: 7 a click elsewhere closes it and leaves the focus where it went
steps.js: (async () => { T.q('#chat').click(); await T.sleep(200); return { open: T.open(), focus: T.act() }; })()

steps.label: 8 the other icon switches panels
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); T.icon('knows').click(); await T.sleep(200); return { open: T.open(), heading: T.q('#side-title').textContent, proposalsExpanded: T.icon('proposals').getAttribute('aria-expanded'), knowsExpanded: T.icon('knows').getAttribute('aria-expanded') }; })()

steps.label: 9 an open panel follows the conversation without closing or losing the focus
steps.js: (async () => { const turns = () => [...T.q('#side-body').querySelectorAll('.kv')].find((e) => e.textContent.includes('turns')).textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' '); const before = turns(); T.q('#side-panel [data-act=side-close]').focus(); await T.send('Anything else?'); return { before, after: turns(), open: T.open(), focus: T.act() }; })()

steps.label: 9b an unchanged panel is not rebuilt: the focused button stays the same element
steps.js: (async () => { T.q('#side-panel [data-act=side-close]').click(); await T.sleep(100); T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); const btn = T.q('#side-panel [data-act=start-feature]'); btn.focus(); let changes = 0; const mo = new MutationObserver((m) => { changes += m.length; }); mo.observe(T.q('#side-panel'), {childList: true, subtree: true}); mo.observe(T.q('#rail'), {childList: true, subtree: true}); await T.send('One more thing'); mo.disconnect(); return { changes, same: document.activeElement === btn, open: T.open() }; })()

steps.label: 9c with a panel open, the chat header (Expand) stays reachable
steps.js: (() => { const e = T.q('[data-act=chat-expand]'); const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2); return { expandReachable: e.contains(hit), panelTopBelowHeader: T.q('#side-panel').getBoundingClientRect().top >= T.q('#chat-col .chat-head').getBoundingClientRect().bottom }; })()

steps.label: 10 the message box grows: the panel still ends above it
steps.js: (async () => { T.q('#side-panel [data-act=side-close]').click(); await T.sleep(100); T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); const b = T.q('#say'); b.value = 'line\n'.repeat(12); b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(200); const gap = Math.round(T.q('#chat-col .composer').getBoundingClientRect().top - T.q('#side-panel').getBoundingClientRect().bottom); const scrolls = T.q('#side-panel').scrollHeight > T.q('#side-panel').clientHeight; b.value = ''; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return { gap, panelScrollsInside: scrolls }; })()

steps.label: 11 Where it was proposed: closes, brings the chat's card into view and focuses it
steps.js: (async () => { [...document.querySelectorAll('#side-panel [data-act=side-where]')].find((e) => e.dataset.title === 'Low-stock warning').click(); await T.sleep(300); const a = document.activeElement; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); const chat = T.q('#chat').getBoundingClientRect(); return { open: T.open(), focused: a.dataset.proposal, flash: a.classList.contains('flash'), inView: r.top >= chat.top && r.bottom <= chat.bottom + 1 }; })()

steps.label: 11b the shown proposal keeps its mark and the focus through a redraw of the chat
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); [...document.querySelectorAll('#side-panel [data-act=side-where]')].find((e) => e.dataset.title === 'Low-stock warning').click(); await T.sleep(100); const b = T.q('#say'); b.value = 'Quick'; b.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(900); const a = document.activeElement; const r = { focused: a.dataset.proposal || a.id, flash: !!document.querySelector('#chat-list .proposal.flash') }; await T.sleep(1500); r.flashAfter = !!document.querySelector('#chat-list .proposal.flash'); return r; })()

steps.label: 12 the / menu opens the panels
steps.js: (async () => { for (let k = 0; k < 40 && document.getElementById('working'); k++) await T.sleep(250); await T.sleep(800); const b = T.q('#say'); b.focus(); b.value = '/'; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(200); b.value = '/proposed'; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(300); b.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(300); const r = { open: T.open(), heading: T.open() ? T.q('#side-title').textContent : null, focus: T.act(), box: b.value }; T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); return r; })()

steps.label: 12b the / menu opens What the lead knows too
steps.js: (async () => { const b = T.q('#say'); b.focus(); b.value = '/what'; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(400); b.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); await T.sleep(300); const r = { open: T.open(), heading: T.open() ? T.q('#side-title').textContent : null, focus: T.act() }; T.icon('knows').click(); await T.sleep(200); return r; })()

steps.label: 12c a file open in place of the chat: the panel starts under its header, whose buttons stay reachable
steps.js: (async () => { T.q('#ptab-files').click(); await T.sleep(1500); const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act=f-open]')][0]; f.click(); await T.sleep(1200); T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(300); const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('#file-view .fv-head button')]; const reach = btns.map((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return e.contains(document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2)); }); const r = { fileOpen: !T.q('#file-view').hidden, open: T.open(), buttons: btns.length, allReachable: reach.every(Boolean), belowHeader: T.q('#side-panel').getBoundingClientRect().top >= T.q('#file-view .fv-head').getBoundingClientRect().bottom }; return r; })()

steps.label: 12d back to the chat
steps.js: (async () => { T.icon('proposals').click(); T.q('#ptab-features').click(); await T.sleep(500); return { open: T.open(), chat: !T.q('#chat-col').hidden }; })()

steps.label: 13 Expand keeps the rail; the panel still opens
steps.js: (async () => { T.q('[data-act=chat-expand]') && T.q('[data-act=chat-expand]').click(); await T.sleep(300); const left = T.q('.column.wide'); const shown = left && getComputedStyle(left).display !== 'none'; T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); const r = { leftShown: shown, rail: getComputedStyle(T.q('#rail')).display, open: T.open() }; T.icon('proposals').click(); T.q('[data-act=chat-expand]') && T.q('[data-act=chat-expand]').click(); await T.sleep(300); return r; })()

steps.label: narrow
14 narrow window: the panel sits in the page above the chat, no sideways scroll
steps.js: (async () => { await T.sleep(300); T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(300); const p = T.q('#side-panel'); return { open: T.open(), position: getComputedStyle(p).position, aboveChat: p.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= T.q('#chat-col').getBoundingClientRect().top, sideways: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth }; })()

steps.label: wide
15 Start spec session from the panel starts it; back on the project it has left the panel
steps.js: (async () => { await T.sleep(300); if (!T.open()) { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); } [...document.querySelectorAll('#side-panel [data-act=start-feature]')].find((e) => e.dataset.title === 'Receipt by e-mail').click(); await T.sleep(2500); const went = location.hash; location.hash = '#/p/repo'; await T.sleep(2500); T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(300); return { went, badge: T.q('#rail .dot') && T.q('#rail .dot').textContent, titles: [...document.querySelectorAll('#side-panel .prop .b')].map((e) => e.textContent) }; })()

steps.label: 15b the started proposal shows Started in the chat, with the way to its feature
steps.js: (async () => { const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('#chat-list .proposal')].find((e) => e.dataset.proposal === 'Receipt by e-mail'); const a = card.querySelector('a.btn'); return { startButton: !!card.querySelector('[data-act=start-feature]'), link: a ? a.textContent : null, href: a ? a.getAttribute('href') : null }; })()

steps.label: 15c clicking Start three times at once makes one feature
steps.js: (async () => { if (!T.open()) { T.icon('proposals').click(); await T.sleep(200); } const before = document.querySelectorAll('#features-pane a.feat').length; const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#side-panel [data-act=start-feature]')].find((e) => e.dataset.title === 'Low-stock warning'); let posts = 0; const real = window.fetch; window.fetch = (u, o) => { if (String(u).endsWith('/features') && o && o.method === 'POST') posts++; return real(u, o); }; b.click(); b.click(); b.click(); await T.sleep(2500); window.fetch = real; const alerted = !!document.getElementById('alert-line'); const went = location.hash; location.hash = '#/p/repo'; await T.sleep(2500); const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('#features-pane a.feat')].map((e) => e.textContent.replace(/[ ]+/g, ' ').trim()); return { went, posts, alerted, added: names.length - before, lowStock: names.filter((n) => n.includes('Low-stock')).length }; })()

steps.label: 15d a second feature of that name is refused by Fallow; the chat's Started link opens the feature
steps.js: (async () => { const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('#chat-list .proposal')].find((e) => e.dataset.proposal === 'Low-stock warning'); const server = await Fallow.post('/api/projects/repo/features', {title: 'low-stock  WARNING'}).then(() => 'created', (e) => 'refused: ' + e.message); card.querySelector('a.btn') && card.querySelector('a.btn').click(); await T.sleep(1500); const opened = location.hash; location.hash = '#/p/repo'; await T.sleep(2500); return { server, opened, cardLink: card.querySelector('a.btn') && card.querySelector('a.btn').textContent }; })()

steps.label: 16 leaving the project closes the panel; it comes back closed
steps.js: (async () => { location.hash = '#/'; await T.sleep(1500); location.hash = '#/p/repo'; await T.sleep(2500); return { open: T.open(), expanded: T.icon('proposals').getAttribute('aria-expanded') }; })()

steps.label: 17 a project page that fails to load listens to no other project
steps.js: (async () => { const conv = document.querySelector('#rail') && (await Fallow.get('/api/projects/repo')).conversation.id; location.hash = '#/p/no-such-project'; await T.sleep(2000); let gets = 0; const real = window.fetch; window.fetch = (u, o) => { if (String(u).includes('/api/projects/no-such-project')) gets++; return real(u, o); }; await Fallow.post(`/api/conversations/${conv}/say`, {text: 'Anything else?'}); await T.sleep(6000); window.fetch = real; return { errorCard: !!document.querySelector('.card.empty'), reloadsOfTheMissingProject: gets }; })()
